title: Djamaa el Djazair (Great Mosque of Algiers)
summary: The Great Mosque of Algiers, Djamaa el Djazair, was built between 2012 and 2019 and opened on 29 April 2019, according to Guinness World Records. Its minaret, designed by KSP Engel, is 265 m tall by the architects' figure and 264.3 m as measured by Guinness, making it the tallest in the world.

uncertainty.note: Guinness World Records says the complex was built between 2012 and 2019 and opened on 29 April 2019; Egis says the mosque opened officially after 16 years of construction in a news item dated 2024. End is the present.
